per_cell.what: independent of the target: S_{m+1} by resultants (split by power of x_R), its elementary-symmetric rewrite, X^(2^t) mod P, the R_j tower

per_target.what: substituting x_R, scaling by powers of g, S_3 boxes, tower and membership equations

construction.unit: field multiplications counted by examples/pkm_oracle_program/algebra.rs (every Pol::mul and Pol::scale, including the p-1 scaling inside Pol::sub); additions not counted; per_cell is shared by every target of the cell and is metered once per export process

extraction.lift_note: x_i must be a real base abscissa; decomposition = sorted signed-symbol list whose point sum is exactly R (R lifted to y <= (p-1)/2; counts are invariant under R -> -R)
extraction.method: f4_fp::solve_visit, unrestricted domains (a second F4 run plus substitution tree, charged to extraction)

solution_semantics_detail.exact_on: F_p-rational decompositions with pairwise distinct abscissae and no identity partial sums in the arm's fixed order
solution_semantics_detail.extra_algebraic_solutions: the monolithic extras (non-rational or identity partial sums)
solution_semantics_detail.lifting: x_i must be a real base abscissa; decomposition = sign patterns whose point sum is exactly R, verified by counted point additions
solution_semantics_detail.not_representable: decompositions with a repeated abscissa (P | X^(2^t) - c forces P squarefree): only DISTINCT abscissae are seen, e.g. 2*P_i or P_i + (-P_i) are not representable
solution_semantics_detail.tower_vs_direct: exactly equivalent over F_p: y_{i,0} = x_i/g, y^(2^t) = 1 iff x^(2^t) = g^(2^t)
solution_semantics_detail.wires: no wires; unordered: permutations identified, solution count is the unordered one

extraction.verified_decomposition_format: list of decompositions, each a list of [x, sign] pairs (sign +1 = the point with y <= (p-1)/2, -1 = its negative), pairs sorted by (x, sign), decompositions sorted lexicographically
